details.summary: Spanish politician and sixth Secretary General of the Council of Europe 1984-1989
details.life: Was born 13 February 1935 in Madrid, Spain. He is the son of Marcelino Oreja Elósegui, industrialist and politician, and María Pureza Aguirre Isasi. On 4 July 1967 he married Silvia Arburúa Aspiunza. They have two sons.
